message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a dark blue top third and a light blue lower two-thirds. At the top, the large white capitalized text "TEMPO" is partially obscured by two giant, purple-toned profile heads facing each other. Below this, white text reads "GEGERAN FORMULA E," followed by a paragraph mentioning "Listyo Sigit Prabowo," "Firli Bahuri," and "Formula E." 

The giant figure on the left, shown from the chest up, has a hand pointing a thick index finger toward the center. The giant figure on the right also points inward with a finger that has two dark arrow shapes on its knuckle. Both have stern expressions and deeply lined faces. Between them, a small man in a light grey racing suit stands behind a sleek, open-wheeled formula racing car. The car is dark grey with large exposed tires. The racer looks up at the giant figures with an open-mouthed, concerned expression, holding a blue helmet in one hand. At the bottom left are barcodes and publication details, including "10-16 APRIL 2023" and "RP 50.000."
